title: Boolean parity function
statement: For a natural number $n$ and a subset $S\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, define the Boolean parity function on $x\in\{0,1\}^n$ by transporting the parity function on the sign cube through the coordinatewise Boolean-to-sign encoding and its inverse.
caveat: The snippet does not include definitions of the sign encoding or of the sign-cube parity function, so their precise conventions cannot be stated here.
